_about: Groups of settings that are reset together. Read by resets.py. A group puts back the forge_theme settings it names ("sections": every setting of those Settings pages, including the copies a page collects with `also`; "keys": single settings), the auto-close rules ("autoclose": true) and runs System actions ("system": panel, action, label, and an optional body and "option" a person can untick). "card": true lists the group on the Reset groups card; a System panel names its own group in system_settings/panels.json ("reset") for the button at its foot. Adding a group is one entry here. "keep_on_reset_all" lists the settings Reset all settings leaves alone because they are things he made, not choices (app folders, hidden and archived apps, saved size mixes, company profiles, and the look kept for Back to my old look). "keep_on_page_reset" lists more settings a page or group reset leaves alone (the look: a layout reset should not turn the Business look off); Reset all still resets them.

groups.label: Visual effects
groups.about: Glass and blur, shadows, animations, particles, the 3D wallpaper, the visualiser, background mode's beat effects and the desktop's particles and visualiser.

groups.label: Power and frame rates
groups.about: Every Speed and detail setting: frame rate caps, the battery versions, the low battery saver, easing off when the GPU is busy, video quality.

groups.label: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
groups.about: Forgets saved Wi-Fi networks and paired Bluetooth devices. Nothing in Forge's own settings changes.

option.label: Keep the network in use now

groups.label: Look and size
groups.about: The look, colours, glass, layout, sizes and the accent colour. The wallpaper stays.

groups.label: Bar, dock, home screen and widgets
groups.about: The top bar and dock, the home screen, widgets, the desktop's widgets and full screen.

groups.label: Auto-close rules
groups.about: Every app's RAM and idle rule back to its default.

groups.label: Keyboard shortcuts
groups.about: Forge's own keys back to the ones it came with.

groups.label: Display
